review:
A shape-shifting heroine who turns into an amber dragon, on 5x3 and 25 lines. Two bonuses: free spins from three scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5, and a Gold Respin from six or more coins.

The Gold Respin can trigger in the base game or during free spins, and uses Plus Spin and Collect symbols, with a Mega jackpot of 5,000x the bet. 5,624x max and 96.14% RTP; BGaming doesn't publish a volatility rating for this one. Free spins about once every 182 spins.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
